tools.name: find_my_icon
tools.description: Find icons this Claycut account already generated or edited, so you can reuse one instead of paying for a new generation. Needs a Claycut key; free. Check here before generate_app_icon. Returns concept, style, date and download URL for matches, or the account's recent icons if nothing matches.

tools.name: edit_app_icon
tools.description:
Change one thing about an icon that is almost right, keeping everything else as it is. Needs a paid Claycut key and costs one icon. Returns a download URL for the edited transparent PNG.

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "generate_app_icon" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Generate a custom transparent PNG app icon or UI illustration of any subject, in the project's own style. Needs a paid Claycut key. Returns a download URL for t…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
